messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-4827 fired for eu-west-1 — p99 latency > 2.5s for 3m. SLO burn: p99=2.9s, p95=1.2s. Affected route(s): /v1/generate. Link: <https://pagerduty.example/PD-4827>
Priya (oncall): Acked. I'm taking this, starting initial triage.
Alex SRE: Acknowledged. Is this across Dedicated and Hosted or just hosted eu-west?
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-4827 assigned to Priya (oncall). Escalation level: on-call.
Priya (oncall): Looking at top hosts — gw-eu-03 and gw-eu-07 showing p99 ~3.2s. KV cache evictions spiked ~00:05 UTC. Pulling kvcache-metrics now.
Jess (eng-runtime): FYI we rolled a routing preference change ~8m ago that favored lower-cost hosts in eu-west, could be creating imbalance.
Priya (oncall): Quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n inference gw-eu-03 -o wide` shows CPU 92%, GPU mem 78%. Logs have repeated `KVCacheRejects: 1200/min`.
Alex SRE: Can you paste the autoscaler events? `kubectl describe hpa gw-eu` — want to see if HPA is reacting.
Priya (oncall): HPA hasn't scaled in 10m; describe shows `Warning  FailedReconcile  10m  horizontalpodautoscaler-controller  failed to reconcile: API rate limit` and queue length on sidecar is high (avg 250).
Marco (eng-infra): I'm checking control plane — seeing API 429s from the controller around 00:02 UTC. Looks correlated with an ops-nightly job that replayed many CRs. Starting rollback of that job.
Priya (oncall): Trying manual scale to relieve pressure: `kubectl scale deployment gw-eu --replicas=6 -n inference`
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-4827 update: Priya (oncall) acknowledged and initiated manual scale (message: "manual scale attempt").
Jess (eng-runtime): If KV cache thrash is root cause, we can enable prefix-caching fallback for eu-west and reduce cache churn. I can flip config if scale doesn't stabilize.
Priya (oncall): New pods coming up, p95 trending down to 0.9s already, p99 trending toward 1.8s. Monitoring over two deployment cycles.
Alex SRE: Any customer-facing errors (5xx) or request drops?
Priya (oncall): No 5xx spike, error rate stable. Impact is increased latency only — some interactive flows may feel sluggish. Preparing short status note for customer-impact.
Marco (eng-infra): Confirmed ops-nightly job caused controller 429s; rolling back that job now, HPA should resume normal reconciliation. Will follow up with changelog entry.
Jess (eng-runtime): Enabling prefix cache fallback: `curl -X POST https://ops-api.local/config -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"prefix_cache":"fallback","scope":"eu-west"}'`
Priya (oncall): Fallback enabled. p99 now 1.4s and holding. Leaving this thread open for a 15m observation window.
Alex SRE: Nice mitigation. Next steps: add a follow-up ticket to harden autoscaler retry/backoff logic and pause ops-nightly during control-plane heavy maintenance.
Priya (oncall): Filed INF-1234 for autoscaler hardening and INF-1235 to add safe-window to ops-nightly. Status note draft: "PD-4827: p99 latency spike in eu-west caused by KV cache thrash + controller API throttling from ops-nightly job. Manual scale + cache fallback stabilized latency; no 5xx/error-rate increase. Follow-ups opened."
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-4827 remains open. Next automated check-in scheduled in 10m.
